extracted.intended_audience: authors (new and established) seeking representation; prospective submitters to Trident Media Group
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance for authors on how to prepare and send query letters and submissions to the literary agency Trident Media Group, including what to include in a query, what not to send, genres accepted, contact details, and commission terms.

rubrics_metrics.name: Verify agent-specific query/submission guidelines
rubrics_metrics.description: The Market List recommends you verify the query and/or submission guidelines for each literary agent and literary agency before sending a query or submitting your manuscript.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Check the individual agent/agency requirements (format, materials requested, restrictions) on their site before submitting; do not rely solely on aggregated listings.

rubrics_metrics.name: Completed manuscript may be required
rubrics_metrics.description: Most agencies require a completed manuscript prior to queries or submissions.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Ensure your manuscript is finished if the agent/agency expects a complete manuscript; confirm this requirement on the agency/agent page.

rubrics_metrics.name: Check requirements for new or unpublished writers
rubrics_metrics.description: Review and verify the agency requirements for working with new or unpublished writers as well as their specific areas of interest.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Some agents/agency imprints may not consider debut authors or may have genre preferences — confirm before querying.

rubrics_metrics.name: One-agent-only query policy
rubrics_metrics.description: Query letters should be sent to one agent only.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Do not send the same query to multiple agents at Trident Media Group simultaneously; follow the agency's stated submission protocol.

rubrics_metrics.name: Query letter content requirements
rubrics_metrics.description: Query letters should include a paragraph about yourself, a brief plot synopsis and your contact information.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Keep the query concise and include author bio, a succinct synopsis of the work, and clear contact details so the agent can respond.

rubrics_metrics.name: Do not include manuscript or proposal with query
rubrics_metrics.description: Do not include a manuscript or proposal.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Submit only the requested query materials; if the agent requests sample pages or a full manuscript, follow those instructions — otherwise do not attach manuscripts.

rubrics_metrics.name: Genres and categories accepted
rubrics_metrics.description: Accepts: Autobiography, biography, crime, current affairs, detective, government, humor, juvenile fiction, law, literary fiction, memoirs, military, multicultural, mystery, police, pop culture, politics, short story collections, suspense, thriller, true crime, war, women's fiction, women's issues, women's studies, young adult fiction and non-fiction.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Ensure your submission falls within one of the listed categories or an area the agency/agent represents; genre fit is important.

rubrics_metrics.name: Market types represented
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Trident Media Group handles both fiction and non-fiction book projects; confirm agent specialties for subgenres.

rubrics_metrics.name: Agency commission terms
rubrics_metrics.description: Agency Terms: Agent receives 15% commission for domestic sales and 20% commission for foreign sales. Agent receives 15% commission for film and TV sales.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Be aware of standard commission rates and that foreign and media rights may be commissioned at different rates.

rubrics_metrics.name: Submission address and phone
rubrics_metrics.description: Submission Address: 41 Madison Avenue, 36th Floor, New York NY 10010. Phone: (212) 262-4810.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use the provided physical mailing address or phone contact as appropriate and verify whether mailed submissions are accepted versus electronic submission on the agency website.

rubrics_metrics.name: Agent contact details and emails
rubrics_metrics.description: Primary Contacts: [list of agents]. Email: See agency website for individual agents' email addresses.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Direct queries to the appropriate agent; obtain current email addresses and submission instructions from the agency website rather than third-party listings.

rubrics_metrics.name: Provide feedback/comment if you have prior submission experience
rubrics_metrics.description: If you have recently submitted to Trident Media Group, LLC or have experience with a specific agent, please submit a comment below.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The listing invites community feedback on submission experiences, which can help other authors understand practices and response norms.
